import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run
def ok(): return {'status':'ok'}
def w(label,q,ttl,res,pay): return (((label<<12)|(q<<9)|256|ttl).to_bytes(4,'big')+res+pay).hex()
tests=[]
def T(n,r,e): tests.append((n,json.dumps(r),e))

# no D bytes at all
f1 = {'id':'nd','path':['a','b'],'template':'0000000000000000','kinds':'KKKKQZTK','labels':[16,16]}
hdr1 = '0000000005000900'
T('no-D', {'mode':'replay','capacities':{'a':1,'b':1},'flows':[f1],
           'events':[{'op':'put','flow':'nd','node':'a'},{'op':'put','flow':'nd','node':'b'},
                     {'op':'enable','flow':'nd'},
                     {'op':'packet','flow':'nd','header':hdr1,'payload':''}]},
  {'results':[ok(),ok(),ok(),{'mode':'mpls','reason':'compressed',
      'wire':[w(16,5,9,b'',b''), w(16,5,8,b'',b'')],
      'delivered':'0000000005000800','byte_hops':8}],
   'active':['nd'],'tables':[{'node':'a','label':16,'flow':'nd'},{'node':'b','label':16,'flow':'nd'}]})
# D at offset 0, single K, Z run, Q at 2
f2 = {'id':'d0','path':['a','b'],'template':'ffffffffffffffff','kinds':'DKQZZZZT','labels':[1048575,16]}
hdr2 = '41ff0300000000ff'
T('d0-full', {'mode':'replay','capacities':{'a':1,'b':1},'flows':[f2],
              'events':[{'op':'put','flow':'d0','node':'a'},{'op':'put','flow':'d0','node':'b'},
                        {'op':'enable','flow':'d0'},
                        {'op':'packet','flow':'d0','header':hdr2,'payload':'ee'}]},
  {'results':[ok(),ok(),ok(),{'mode':'mpls','reason':'compressed',
      'wire':[w(1048575,3,255,b'A',b'\xee'), w(16,3,254,b'A',b'\xee')],
      'delivered':'41ff0300000000fe' + 'ee','byte_hops':12}],
   'active':['d0'],'tables':[{'node':'a','label':1048575,'flow':'d0'},{'node':'b','label':16,'flow':'d0'}]})
T('d0-ttl0', {'mode':'replay','capacities':{'a':1,'b':1},'flows':[f2],
              'events':[{'op':'put','flow':'d0','node':'a'},{'op':'put','flow':'d0','node':'b'},
                        {'op':'enable','flow':'d0'},
                        {'op':'packet','flow':'d0','header':'41ff030000000000','payload':'ee'}]},
  {'results':[ok(),ok(),ok(),{'mode':'mpls','reason':'compressed','wire':[],'delivered':None,'byte_hops':0}],
   'active':['d0'],'tables':[{'node':'a','label':1048575,'flow':'d0'},{'node':'b','label':16,'flow':'d0'}]})
# template junk at D/Z/Q/T positions must be irrelevant; Q=7 boundary
f3 = {'id':'j','path':['a','b'],'template':'ffffffffffffff0b','kinds':'ZZZZZZQT','labels':[16,1048575]}
# kinds has no K -> invalid, so add K
f3 = {'id':'j','path':['a','b'],'template':'ffffffffffffff0b','kinds':'ZZZZZKQT','labels':[16,1048575]}
hdr3 = 'ffffffffffff07ff'   # K at 5 must be ff; Q at 6 = 7; T at 7 = 255
T('q7', {'mode':'replay','capacities':{'a':1,'b':1},'flows':[f3],
         'events':[{'op':'put','flow':'j','node':'a'},{'op':'put','flow':'j','node':'b'},
                   {'op':'enable','flow':'j'},
                   {'op':'packet','flow':'j','header':hdr3,'payload':''}]},
  {'results':[ok(),ok(),ok(),{'mode':'mpls','reason':'compressed',
      'wire':[w(16,7,255,b'',b''), w(1048575,7,254,b'',b'')],
      'delivered':'ffffff000000ff' + '07' + 'fe','byte_hops':8}],
   'active':['j'],'tables':[{'node':'a','label':16,'flow':'j'},{'node':'b','label':1048575,'flow':'j'}]})
got = run([t[1] for t in tests])
fails=0
for (name,_l,exp),g in zip(tests,got):
    if g != exp:
        fails+=1; print('FAIL',name,'\n exp',json.dumps(exp),'\n got',json.dumps(g))
print('cases',len(tests),'failures',fails)
